using NUnit.Framework;

// Saved as .txt rather than .cs. cyber-dojo.sh hands the compiler the files
// that find names for *.cs, so this one is never compiled and NUnit never
// sees the test. Calling it something other than HikerTest.cs would not have
// been enough on its own: NUnit gathers tests by the [Test] attribute and
// does not care which file they came from, so a .cs file under any name at
// all still runs. The extension is what keeps this one out.
//
// The assertion below is one that would fail, so a green says this really
// did not run rather than that it ran and passed.
public class AnswerSizeTest
{
    [Test]
    public void the_answer_is_three_digits_long()
    {
        Assert.That(new Hiker().Answer().ToString().Length, Is.EqualTo(3));
    }
}
